+## Twelve lenses
+
+### Aset
+
+SSSES (business case): security 93 · stability 93 · scalability 91 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90

+Consistency is a figure that reads the same to the analyst and to the reader who never trained in finance, and the deck's growth rate, three-year CAGR of one hundred fifteen percent, wore three letters a plain reader could not open. The operator asked for this rate by name, then the deck printed it and left it stamped. This round writes compound annual growth rate beside CAGR where the reader first meets it, drawn from the master's ramp. Founder, your growth figure now speaks to every reader, not only the analyst. Investors, the rate you weigh names itself. Future customers, the growth is legible to you from its first appearance, plainly.

+### Asar

+SSSES (business case): security 93 · stability 93 · scalability 90 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90
+
+Synthesis is the whole case closing in one reading, and a case that turns on a growth rate no plain reader can open has not closed. The deck's headline growth, three-year CAGR of one hundred fifteen percent, is the figure an investor pairs with return, yet CAGR was spelled out nowhere a reader meets it. This round resolves it at its first shown appearance: compound annual growth rate, the pace the ramp keeps from six accounts to sixty. Founder, the case now closes for the reader without a finance degree. Investors, the growth names itself where you first read it. Future customers, the meaning of the deck's growth is whole, plainly.

+
+SSSES (business case): security 94 · stability 93 · scalability 91 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90

A reviewer without finance training met the growth figure and could not weigh it. This round writes compound annual growth rate where the term first appears, on the financial slide, drawn from the master's ramp. Founder, the pace your whole ramp rests on now reads for every reviewer. Investors, you weigh a named growth rate, not an acronym. Future customers, the discipline behind the number is legible to you, whatever your training, where the deck names it.

Founder, this is candour, the number in plain words. Investors, every reader now holds one meaning of the headline growth.
